buff_text: Melee attacks cause an additional [1.2 * (1689 * 1.2 * 1.03 * Mainhand weapon max base speed / 100) + 0.03 * (Mainhand weapon max damage + Mainhand weapon min damage) / 2 + 1] Holy damage.
name: Seal of Righteousness
description: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional [1.2 * (1689 * 1.2 * 1.03 * Mainhand weapon max base speed / 100) + 0.03 * (Mainhand weapon max damage + Mainhand weapon min damage) / 2 + 1] Holy damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 155 to 168 Holy damage to an enemy.
